subject: Qualification recap: procurement path, AP constraints, and marketplace preference
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@aureushealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo follow-up: procurement & payment questions

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today — the team appreciated the low-latency routing examples. A couple of procurement questions came up that I wanted to capture here so we can move toward a pilot decision:

- AP routing: Do you accept corporate card for one-off charges? If not, what thresholds typically force a PO?
- Vendor onboarding: We need your vendor paperwork (W9 + vendor intake form). Is that something you can provide now?
- Marketplace vs direct: Our IT procurement prefers buying through the Azure Marketplace to simplify billing, but Procurement told me they’ll consider a direct vendor if the onboarding is faster. Do you have a marketplace listing or an alternative that speeds vendor activation?

If you can send the vendor onboarding packet and a short note on your preferred commercial path (card vs PO thresholds, typical invoice terms), I’ll share with our AP team. I attached Aureus_PO_Requirements.pdf that outlines our internal guidelines.

Thanks,
Emily Chen
Procurement Manager
Aureus Health
attachments: Aureus_PO_Requirements.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@aureushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up: procurement & payment questions

Hi Emily — great to meet you today. Short recap + next steps below.

Recap (from our end):
- Pilot scope: 3 models, RB inference hosted, 30k monthly tokens estimated.
- Success metric: <150ms p50 latency for API calls with typical payloads.
- Security: We can run in VPC/dedicated capacity if needed; we also support marketplace options.

Procurement / AP answers and asks:
- Card vs PO: We can accept corporate card for charges up to $5,000 per month. Anything above $5k typically goes through PO / invoice. We surface this as a configurable threshold per account.
- Invoice terms: Standard Net30 for direct invoices; we support monthly invoicing and can do Net30 by default.
- Vendor onboarding: attaching our Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Guide.pdf and a W9 template for your team to pass to AP.
- Marketplace: We are listed in the AWS Marketplace today; Azure listing is in progress (ETA 6–8 weeks). If your procurement prefers marketplace, we can expedite a marketplace-friendly purchase order, but direct vendor is usually faster for pilots.

Questions for AP to confirm (quick):
1) Who is the AP contact (name + email) that handles vendor setup?
2) Is there a finance threshold that requires a multi-step approval beyond $5k?
3) Does Aureus require any specific insurance or PO wording?

Next steps:
- I’ll send the onboarding packet now (attached).
- If you want, I can loop in our finance manager (Marissa) to help with vendor setup timing and any PO paperwork.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Guide.pdf, W9_template.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood demo follow-up: procurement & payment questions

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Aureus Health procurement thread. Quick ask: can you confirm the following so I can provide a single clear reply?

- Marissa: what is our expected turnaround for vendor activation when AP provides completed W9 + vendor intake (typical timeline for Net30 invoicing and PO issuance)? Any flexibility on invoice frequency if they need monthly vs upfront?
- Rishi: do we need any special contract language for healthcare customers (insurance/BAA) for a pilot sized at ~30k tokens per month? Also, can Finance accept a W9 + emailed vendor intake form (or do we require a signed DocuSign packet)?

I’ll plan to push back to Aureus with a consolidated timeline by end of day Wednesday so they can start internal approvals.

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@aureushealth.com>

Cc: procurement@aureushealth.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up: procurement & payment questions

Hi Vivek — thanks for the quick reply and the onboarding docs. Some answers from AP below so you can finalize next steps: 

- Card vs PO: AP will process corporate card charges up to $5,000 total per month. Anything > $5k needs a PO and goes through our three-step approval (tech lead -> procurement -> finance). Expect ~2–3 weeks for PO issuance once a request is raised.
- Vendor paperwork: We require a completed W9 + the vendor intake form (I attached Aureus_vendor_intake_form.pdf). We can accept emailed PDFs for onboarding; DocuSign is preferred for contracts but not required for vendor setup.
- Marketplace: IT prefers marketplace, but procurement will approve direct vendor if the onboarding time is shorter. For a pilot, they recommended direct vendor to avoid marketplace listing delays.

Based on the above, AP recommends: 1) start the pilot on a corporate card to get running if the initial month is under $5k, OR 2) initiate vendor setup today (we’ll target PO issuance in 2–3 weeks). I’ll share the AP contact (Sanjay Rao) in a follow-up email to get the vendor request in queue.

Cheers,
Emily Chen
Procurement Manager
Aureus Health
attachments: Aureus_vendor_intake_form.pdf
